dct_creator_sm: Aboriginal Affairs and Northern Development Canada.
dct_description_sm: The aim of this project is to facilitate data integration, visualization and analysis of existing and BREA associated research projects, as well as develop geospatial toolset in webGIS for BREA. This is intended to aid BREA stakeholders in better understanding the geographic distribution of areas which are sensitive for environmental and socio-economic reasons on the face of economic development. It will demonstrate the value in bringing together regional georeferenced information to support decision making.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Socio-economic impacts
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Decision makers
dct_title_s: A Web-based Geospatial Analysis Tool for BREA: Integrating Research into an Assessment
